categories.archiveHelp: Archiving hides the category from new issues and the grid. Issued credentials and their scans stay on record.
categories.archived: Category archived. Its credentials and scan history stay.
categories.codeHelp: Capitals, digits and hyphens, up to 16 characters, such as ALL-ACCESS.
categories.empty: No credential categories yet. Define who goes where, starting with a category such as CREW.
categories.issuedSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No live credentials in this category.} one {# live credential in this category.} other {# live credentials in this category.}}
categories.meta: {project} · {count, plural, =0 {no live credentials} one {# live credential} other {# live credentials}}
categories.name: Name

collab.noAttachments: No files attached yet. Upload a photo or document that belongs with this record.
collab.noComments: No comments yet. Start the discussion about this record here.
collab.scanning: Being checked for viruses; download opens once the check passes.
collab.uploaded: File uploaded. It can be downloaded once the virus check passes.

common.chooseProject: Choose a project first. Credentials, zones and the access grid belong to one project.
common.errorSentence: This page could not load. Try again; if it keeps failing, send the reference to your administrator.
common.noProjects: There are no projects you can open yet. Create a project, then come back to set up credentials.
common.recordMissing: This record does not exist or you cannot open it. Return to the list to pick another.
common.timeZoneHelp: Times are in {zone}, the project's time zone.

errors.confirmRevoke: Tick the box to confirm the revocation, then try again.
errors.conflict: That value is already used. Choose another and try again.
errors.dispatchInput: Choose a responder, then try again.
errors.encounterInput: Describe the patient without medical detail, then try again.
errors.fileInput: Choose a file to upload, then try again.
errors.fileNotReady: This file is not ready yet. Try again once its virus check passes.
errors.fileSize: Files can be up to 50 MB. Choose a smaller file.
errors.gridInput: Choose a category, a zone and an access level, then try again.
errors.incidentInput: Say what happened and choose a severity, then try again.
errors.invalid: Some values are out of range. Check the fields and try again.
errors.issueInput: Choose a category and a holder, then try again.
errors.mediaInput: Enter the stored file path, then try again.
errors.notFound: This record no longer exists or you cannot change it. Reload the page.

rules.credential_engagement_project: The engagement belongs to another project. Choose an engagement on this project.

rules.credential_revoked: This credential is revoked and stays revoked. Issue a new one.
rules.credential_self_issue: You cannot issue a credential to yourself. Ask another issuer.
rules.credential_unknown: No credential matches that number. Check the badge and try again.
rules.dispatch_id_taken: Another dispatch already uses this id.

rules.incident_device_time_future: The report time is later than now. Check the device clock.

rules.incident_party_id_taken: Another party already uses this id.

errors.scanInput: Choose a zone and type a credential number, then try again.
errors.signoffInput: Write a sign-off note, then close the incident.
errors.unexpected: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

grid.empty: No zone access granted yet. Grant a category entry to a zone to start the grid.
grid.explain: Each row lets one category enter one zone at a canon access level during a window. Scans are decided from this grid by the database.
grid.matrixHelp: Toggling a cell grants {level} for the next 30 days or withdraws the pair. Change levels and windows in the Spreadsheet view.
grid.needsCategories: The access grid needs credential categories. Create one for this project first.
grid.needsZones: The access grid needs zones. Add zones to the project's venue in Places.
grid.tableAlternative: Show the grid as a table

issued.empty: No credentials issued yet. Issue badges to crew, vendors and guests.
issued.emptyFiltered: No credentials match these filters. Clear a filter or issue a new credential.
issued.holderHelp: You cannot issue a credential to yourself; another issuer does that.
issued.needsCategory: This project has no credential categories yet. Create one, then issue credentials in it.
issued.revokeConfirm: Revoke {number}. A revoked credential is denied at every zone and cannot be restored.
issued.scansHidden: You cannot read this project's scan log.
issued.validToHelp: Leave empty to keep it valid until revoked.

scans.decided: {number}{holder, select, none {} other { · {holder}}} at {zone}: {decision, select, Granted {access granted} other {access denied}}.
scans.deskHelp: Type the number printed on a badge to check it at a zone. The scan is logged and decided by the database.
scans.empty: No scans yet. Scans appear here as credentials are checked at zones in Compass or at the scan desk.
scans.emptyFiltered: No scans match these filters. Clear a filter to see every scan.

intake.heading: Unresolved scans
intake.help: Codes a device could not match when it scanned them. Each waits here until someone binds it to the catalog or dismisses it. Nothing is matched automatically.
intake.loadError: We could not load the unresolved scans. Reload the page to try again.
intake.noteHelp: Required. For example: a test tag, or a code that belongs to another org.
